application: First-stage transport shortlist for a nonaqueous polymer electrolyte in lithium-metal cells operated at 30 C
origin: Analyst-selected research demonstration after exploratory source reading; not a universal electrolyte threshold, industrial standard or blinded benchmark. Fixed before the independent reference and selector replay on 2026-10-27.
decision_scope: Keep means advance to battery-specific follow-up after this one conductivity check. It does not establish complete battery suitability, practical safety, salted-film healing or device qualification. No ranking across papers or unlike geometries.
eligibility_note: The role, chemistry, formulation and comparator status are reviewed research inputs, not automatically validated by the numeric selector. The PTMG-HDI/LiFSI control is explicitly a performance control, not independently established here as a dynamic-polymer candidate.
protocol_notes: SS denotes the source's blocking steel electrodes. Pei explicitly defines SS as sheet steel. Do not silently expand every SS abbreviation to stainless steel.

Preserve assembly, resistance definition, thickness, salt, residual solvent/plasticizer and frequency range in the observation. This broad entry screen accepts the authors' reported conductivity from SS/electrolyte/SS; it does not assert identical bulk/interface separation or geometry across papers.
No interpolation from 25/35 C, substitution from 60 C, or assignment of an unspecified room temperature to 30 C.
A plotted 30 C point without an exact extracted value remains incomplete; declared figure digitization or raw-data retrieval is a follow-up, not an exact reported measurement.
Do not convert a neat-polymer healing result into a salted-electrolyte result or transfer a wet/plasticized result to a dry matrix.
outside_entry_screen: Exact-salted-formulation healing mechanism, temperature, time and recovered property
Lithium compatibility and cycling at selected current density, areal capacity, temperature and pressure
Oxidative stability and lithium-ion transference number under specified protocols
Full-cell cathode, loading, electrolyte amount, voltage window and rate definition
Mechanical durability, residual solvent, reproducibility and practical safety
